item.title: See how daily habits affect your age estimate
item.summary: In the private You preview, your steps, bedtime regularity, workouts, Food Week and fibre in logged meals can contribute to your age estimate.
item.details: The weekly estimate stays steadier through ordinary watch fluctuations. When you log fibre and calories on at least three days in nine, the estimate can use those meals even if you only logged part of each day.
